# Core2

> M5Stack Core2 (ESP32-D0WDQ6-V3) hardware and firmware knowledge base.

## Summary

This repo documents the M5Stack **Core2** IoT controller: 240 MHz dual-core
Xtensa LX6, 16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM, 2.0" 320×240 ILI9342C capacitive
touchscreen, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi + Bluetooth 4.2, AXP192/AXP2101 PMU, and Grove /
M-Bus expansion. It does **not** run Linux. The custom app is PlatformIO +
**M5Unified**: an AgentForge desk monitor where the **brick talks to AF
directly** over Wi-Fi (no PC middleware). Ops-cube UI on the 320×240
touchscreen (Hub/Pulse/Heat/Trail/Beam/Talk). Auth: project `afp_` key via
`/projects/{slug}/…` routes (not fleet `/stats/*`). Firmware **0.3.5**.
See docs/firmware/VISION.md.

## Do not confuse with

- **CoreS3** — ESP32-S3, camera, USB-OTG
- **Tough** — industrial sealed HMI, different touch IC

## Spec cheat sheet

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| SoC | ESP32-D0WDQ6-V3, dual LX6, 240 MHz, 600 DMIPS |
| Memory | 520 KB SRAM, 16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM |
| Display | 2.0" IPS 320×240 ILI9342C, RGB565 SPI |
| Touch | FT6336U @ 0x38, 3 virtual front buttons |
| Radio | 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n + Bluetooth 4.2 BR/EDR+BLE |
| PMU | AXP192 (v1.0/v1.3) or AXP2101+INA3221 (v1.1) |
| IMU | MPU6886 (v1.0/v1.1) or BMI270 (v1.3) @ 0x68 |
| Battery | 3.7 V, 500 mAh current docs (early units 390 mAh) |
| OS | No Linux. This repo: PlatformIO + M5Unified. Also UiFlow, IDF, CircuitPython, Zephyr |
